title: Prepare the lesson yourself. Let this gather the material.
subtitle: Lesson Prep finds the talks, scriptures and questions that surround an assigned General Conference address. The study, the prayer and the teaching remain yours.

handbook.label: General Handbook 38.8.47, “Appropriate Use of Artificial Intelligence”
handbook.text: The Church teaches that artificial intelligence cannot replace the individual work and spiritual guidance needed to prepare inspired talks, lessons, prayers or blessings, while it may help with research, editing, translation and similar tasks. That is the line this tool is built to respect.
